purpose: Evidence-backed record of external service capabilities available to the Digital Life Form engineering workflow.

github.evidence: GitHub connector can read and write mafiabax/digital-life-form-flywire; branch creation succeeded for v235-service-bridge.
github.role: source control, evidence artifacts, CI orchestration

supabase.evidence: Both available Supabase account links returned an empty project list.
supabase.role: database/auth/backend when a visible project is available

neon.evidence: Neon management tools are available, but the current connection requires an explicit project_id and the available tool surface does not expose project enumeration.
neon.role: Postgres branches, database, snapshots and backend state

wolfram.evidence: Wolfram|Alpha tool returned exact and decimal results for 3732460/138584: 26.9328 and 53.8657.

tinyfish.evidence: TinyFish search returned the authoritative Zenodo FlyWire v783 connectivity dataset record at https://zenodo.org/records/10676866.
tinyfish.role: Web Hand: current web search and rendered-page extraction

security_rule: No credential is stored in this repository. Missing or unavailable service access must remain UNKNOWN/INCOMPLETE rather than being promoted to PASS.
